core_method: composite risk index combining tropical cyclone (TC) regime shifts and sea level rise (SLR)

data_sources.slr: IPCC AR6 regional relative SLR rates (medium confidence)
data_sources.tc: historical TC tracks from MIT MPI-ESM1-2-HR

key_steps: Calculate SLR projection to 2100 from median rates 2020-2100
Calculate baseline TC exposure/frequency from historical tracks
Define TC regime shift (baseline or projected; future projections missing?)
Composite index: normalized SLR + TC risk
Apply to mangroves: per polygon or aggregated
assumptions: TC future = historical baseline (no shift data)
